title: Chapter 142 Golden Fire Cavalry
content:
Chapter 142 Golden Fire Cavalry

Wang Shuo jumped on his horse and rushed into the Gobi Desert first.

Ayub led all the combatants and followed Wang Shuo, disappearing into the distance.

On the way, Wang Shuo thought for a moment and asked Ayub, "Have you used your legion order?"

"My lord, I haven't used it yet. I hope you can give me a name for the first cavalry unit in the territory."

Wang Shuo thought about it and realized that he needed to name his own unit.

But what name should he give it?

After thinking for a while, Wang Shuo's eyes lit up and he had an idea.

"Let's call it 'Golden Fire Cavalry'!" Wang Shuo said excitedly.

Later, Wang Shuo planned to put golden equipment on everyone in the cavalry unit, including the war horses, and all of them would be covered in heavy armor.

Wang Shuo became more and more excited as he thought about it, and couldn't help dancing with joy.

"Yes, let's do it! I must build an invincible heavy cavalry. Wherever I go, the enemy will be terrified!"

"Yes, Lord! I will live up to your trust and build an iron-blooded army for you."

[Ayub used the Legion Order to establish the "Golden Fire Cavalry" Legion, which currently has 21 people. 】

Wang Shuo checked the attributes of the cavalry unit established using the Legion Order.

[Golden Fire Cavalry Legion: Long-range block +20%, speed +20% (attack speed and movement speed), morale +20%. 】

Very good, very powerful.

Wang Shuo did not let the members of the original cavalry team join the Golden Fire Cavalry, but made other arrangements.

Everyone envied the militia team that followed the large army, but no one questioned Wang Shuo's decision.

For the bronze boss of about level 20, Wang Shuo's team can be said to have pushed it directly with a speed that was as fast as a rotten wood.

There was not even a seriously injured soldier.

After killing 5 high-level bronze bosses and clearing the skeleton soldiers encountered on the way, Wang Shuo earned another 10,000 merit points.

As the sky gradually darkened, Wang Shuo exchanged two kinds of talisman paper, handed them to Ayub, and then led everyone back to Wana Village.

After a day of construction, Wana Village has undergone tremendous changes again.

As night fell, the lights came on.

Wang Shuo then discovered that street lights had been installed on the road from the portal to the lord's mansion.

"Oh my god, it's too modern!"

"Is the energy used by this thing obtained by converting energy crystals through energy converters?" Wang Shuo stood on the newly built road and saw Duan Wenxi running over.

"Boss, you are wise." Duan Wenxi smiled and walked over to walk with Wang Shuo.

"All the energy consumption in our territory is provided by that magical energy converter."

Duan Wenxi's voice suddenly became smaller, and he said with some trepidation: "It's just that the energy consumption is a bit high. We need 100 energy crystals every day to maintain various consumption."

After becoming the chief steward of the territory, Duan Wenxi has the authority to add energy crystals to the core of the territory. In the past few days, he has calculated that if Wana Village is initially built, it will consume at least 300 energy crystals every day.

After hearing this, Wang Shuo suddenly said: "Pay attention to energy conservation and emission reduction, and use clean energy."

"It is guaranteed to be clean energy, the kind that does not pollute at all." Duan Wenxi heard that Wang Shuo did not have any abnormal reaction, but instead joked with him, and he felt relieved.

The whole person seemed more confident.

In this Wana Village, he also has a little say, he couldn't help but think so, and his heart was full of joy.

Walking to the center of the village, I found that the blacksmith shop, carpentry workshop and other buildings had been built, just over 100 meters away from the lord's mansion, and some houses were still being built on the open space next to the lord's mansion.

After Wang Shuo asked Duan Wenxi, he knew that this was the residence built for the core personnel of the territory, such as Ayub and Duan Wenxi. Wang Shuo was very satisfied with this and would never treat his men badly.

After dinner, Wang Shuo returned to the bedroom and began to study the "North Sea Empire Text Records".

This thing must be polished with time. Wang Shuo plans to take some time every night to study.
